description: This Java source file defines the class FormWidgetArtifactInfo, which models artifact information related to form widgets within the Apache OFBiz framework. It collects and manages details about forms, including their dependencies on entities, services, linked requests, and inheritance relationships.

classes.name: FormWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: A class that encapsulates comprehensive artifact information about a form widget, including its dependencies on entities, services, inheritance, and linked requests within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates all dependencies and relationships for this form artifact, including entities, services, extended forms, and request links.

methods.name: populateFormExtended
methods.description: Sets up inheritance relationships if this form extends another form, loading parent form info.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity references used by this form based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service references used by this form based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Adds request links associated with this form based on request unique IDs.

methods.name: populateTargetedRequests
methods.description: Adds requests that this form targets based on request unique IDs.
